newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALY SUMMON LOMBARDO, DEL PIERO DOUBTFUL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALY SUMMON LOMBARDO, DEL PIERO DOUBTFUL.

text.p: Veteran Juventus midfielder Attilio Lombardo was called up by Italy on Monday for the four-nation Tournoi de France, starting on Tuesday.
He replaced Piacenza's Eusebio Di Francesco, needed by his club for the serie A relegation playoff against Cagliari on June 14 or 15.
Roma-bound Di Francesco was the first Piacenza player to receive an international call.
Juventus striker Alessandro Del Piero may be left behind when the squad leaves for Nantes later in the day.
Del Piero was hit in the face by the ball during the European Cup final last week and was seeing a specialist on Monday for treatment to the retina of his left eye.
Team officials said Real Madrid libero Christian Panucci would join the squad later on Monday.
They said midfielder Demetrio Albertini would leave the squad after Italy's game against Brazil on June 8 for a minor operation that has been planned for some time.
